description: Get a policy change proposal you made, by its proposalId: its change list, impact, status (PENDING, SUCCEEDED, FAILED, EXPIRED, ...), expiry and outcome. Once SUCCEEDED, result carries what applying it returned (for create_policy, the new policyId and version).

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

proposalId.description: The proposalId returned by propose_policy_change, create_policy or rollback_policy.

name: get_policy_proposal
title: Get a policy change proposal
